divergences.title: Mandatory deployment-tooling verification of official target-chain USDC quote-token address is absent from repository scope

documentProblems: IRaffleFactory.sol:L8-L9 states that 'onchain construction checks only code presence and six-decimal metadata', whereas RaffleFactory.constructor (RaffleFactory.sol:L68, L80-L83, L89-L90) and Raffle.constructor (Raffle.sol:L157 -> VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L45) also validate protocolTreasury_ against zero and protocol plumbing addresses and invoke vrfWrapper_.link() during construction.

IRaffleFactory.sol:L89, IRaffle.sol:L266, RaffleFactory.sol:L152, and Raffle.sol:L587-L589 describe _isProtocolDestination and UnsafeProtocolDestination as screening tokens, ticket owners, and payout recipients against known protocol plumbing, omitting that Raffle.initialize (Raffle.sol:L187-L192) also screens params.sponsor (which receives neither tickets nor payouts) and params.protocolTreasury against params.prizeToken and registered clones.

DESIGN.md:L2 states 'Reserve missed awards 80% gross to winner, 15% sponsor, 5% treasury. ... Rounding is floor on aggregate protocol fee; remainder must be allocated without loss' without specifying the rounding direction of the 80% cash-winner allocation before computing the sponsor remainder, whereas IRaffle.sol:L328, Raffle.sol:L529-L530, and RaffleConstants.sol:L7-L8 specify that both the 5% protocol fee and 80% cash-winner allocation round down via Math.mulDiv and the sponsor receives the remainder.
